unresolved.legacyText: 乌尔戈兹是一个堕落的灵魂，也是埃科瓦尔德森林的前守护者。他曾经是一位高贵的守护者，保护森林和其中的所有生命，并与居住在那里的库兹克人一起维护森林的安全。然而，在玉风石化了大部分森林后，乌尔戈兹和他的守望者追随者开始腐化。它们对生活在森林中的人类的威胁与日俱增。
unresolved.englishDraft: UrgozA corrupt soul and a former guardian of the Ekowald forest. He was a noble guardian,PreservationThe forest and all its life, together with the Kuzk people living there, maintain the safety of the forest. However, after the jade winds have petrorated most of the forests, the forest is now being destroyed by the sea.UrgozAnd his watchmen and followers are starting to corrupt. Their threats to people living in forests are increasing.

unresolved.legacyText: 由阿斯卡隆的毁灭出发，追查白斗篷、马赛特与寻火者预言。其他篇章的角色从狮子拱门一段加入主线。
unresolved.englishDraft: The destruction of Ascalon begins with the pursuit of white cape, marset and fire-hunters.Prophecies. Other chapters fromLion's ArchA section to join the main line.

unresolved.legacyText: 瘟疫侵袭凯珊，东悟与明月带领英雄追查白影的阴谋。凯珊新角色由星岬寺开始；其他篇章角色从北方码头进入凯宁城的剧情。
unresolved.englishDraft: The plague struck Kashan, and East Wing and the Moon led the heroes to pursue the White Shadow.Shing Jea Monastery Started; other chapters of the role from the North Pier into Kening City.

unresolved.legacyText: 伊洛那日戟军对抗瓦蕾丝与阿巴顿的势力。伊洛那角色从伊斯坦训练开始；外来角色通过 Battle Preparations 等任务加入，随后衔接领事馆码头。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Irona Japanese legiones fought against the forces of Wallace and Abbadon. The Ilona role began with the Istanbul training; outsiders passed. Battle Preparations Wait for the mission to join and then connect.Consulate Docks。

unresolved.legacyText: 地震与毁灭者威胁席卷泰瑞亚。英雄经地下通道逃至北方之眼，联合阿苏拉、诺恩和黑檀先锋队，对抗大毁灭者。
unresolved.englishDraft: The earthquake and the destroyer threaten to engulf Tyrea.Eye of the Northand united Assula, Noon and Black Honolulu to fight against the Great Destroyer.

unresolved.legacyText: 毁灭前的训练结束后，角色来到两年后的阿斯卡隆。鲁里克王子在夏尔入侵中组织抵抗，随后率难民越过席娃山脉；他在霜门的撤离途中牺牲。
unresolved.englishDraft: After the training before destruction had ended, the role arrived in Ascalon two years later. Prince Rouric organized resistance during the Shire invasion and then led refugees across the Siva Mountains; he died on his way to the fall of the Frost Gate.

unresolved.legacyText: 抵达科瑞塔后，英雄最初协助白斗篷抵御亡灵。追查获选者的去向时，他们发现白斗篷献祭无辜者，转而与光刃并肩作战；马基斯的背叛迫使众人撤离。
unresolved.englishDraft: When they arrive in Corita, heroes help the white cape to defend itself from the dead. When they track down those who have been selected, they find that the white cloak is a sacrifice for innocent people and instead fights with a bare blade;MarkisThe betrayal forced people to evacuate.

unresolved.legacyText: 在图瑞·欧萨的指引下，英雄通过三项试炼与镜像之战，进入巨龙格琳特的巢穴。格琳特揭示白斗篷主人是马赛特，并解释寻火者预言。
unresolved.englishDraft: Under the guidance of Turi Osa, heroes enter the nest of the giant Lungrint through three battles to test and mirror them. Gretel reveals that the owner of the white cloak is Marcelte and explains the fire-hunters.Prophecies。

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄营救光刃，与先知接触并获得灌注以抵御马赛特的幽灵痛苦，随后帮助矮人夺回雷云要塞。
unresolved.englishDraft: Hero rescues the blade, contacts the Prophet and gets injected to defend him from the ghost pain of Marset, then helps the dwarfs recover it.Thunderhead Keep。

unresolved.legacyText: 基尔布隆引导英雄破坏科马里之门的封印，释放泰坦。他随后暴露巫妖身份，试图借欧尔权杖控制泰坦。英雄最终击败巫妖，再次封闭大门。
unresolved.englishDraft: Kirblon led the hero to break the seal of the Comarie Gate and release Titan. He then exposed himself as a witch, trying to control Titan with his Orbian staff. The hero eventually defeated the demon and closed the gate again.

unresolved.legacyText: 主线结束后，格琳特指引英雄阻止失控泰坦袭击各地，并追击北方的泰坦首领。这是后续任务，不能与最终主线任务混为一项。
unresolved.englishDraft: After the end of the main line, Glynt led his hero to stop the uncontrolled Titan attacks and pursue the northern Titans. This is a follow-up mission that cannot be confused with the final main line mission.

unresolved.legacyText: 东悟与学生在曹大臣庄园发现瘟疫，追查至善台郡后辨认出白影的标记，随后赴凯宁城求援。
unresolved.englishDraft: Dong Go and students found plague at the Minister Cao Manor, traced it to Sen Tai County and identified the white shadow markings before going to Kening City for help.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄在薇茹广场被白影杀死，又由使者复活。为对抗灵魂与白影，他们完成纳普区的试炼，成为 Weh no Su，并在谭纳凯神殿释放古代英雄。
unresolved.englishDraft: The heroes were killed by the white shadows in Viru Square, and the Messenger was raised. They finished fighting against the soul and the white.Nahpui Quarter (explorable area)♪ The test, becomes Weh no SuAndTahnnakai Temple (explorable area) Release the ancient heroes.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄分别取得圣维克特骨灰瓮与阿克摩如斯长矛，在孙江行政区关闭裂隙，却得知圣物只能暂时阻止白影。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero gets the urn of St. Victor and the spear of Achmores,Sunjiang District (explorable area) Close the cracks, but it was learned that sacred objects could only temporarily stop the white shadow.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄可协助库兹柯守护永恒之林，或协助勒克森保护盖拉孵化所的幼龟。面对共同的瘟疫威胁，两方形成合作，故事在沉睡之水重新汇合。
unresolved.englishDraft: A hero can help keep Kuzko safe.The Eternal Grove (explorable area) Or help Lecson.PreservationGyala Hatchery (explorable area)The turtles. In the face of a common plague, we have a partnership.Unwaking Waters (explorable area)Reconnect.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄解除白影对盐蛟昆纳维的控制，攻入莱苏皇宫。东悟为救皇帝牺牲，白影借皇族之血重返人间；英雄随后在帝国圣所击败他。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero has removed the shadow from control of the salt Quinnawi and has invaded.Raisu Palace East Go is the king's salvation, and the shadow returns to the world with blood from the royal family; the hero is now in the house.Imperial Sanctum Beat him.

unresolved.legacyText: 日戟新兵抵御海盗，追查古代遗迹中的恶兆，发现科瑞纳将领卡叶特与海盗合作，并得知瓦蕾丝试图释放阿巴顿。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Japanese recruits resisted pirates, pursued the symptoms of ancient monuments, discovered that General Corina had taken Kait to cooperate with pirates and learned that Wallace was trying to release Abatton.

unresolved.legacyText: 日戟军在领事馆码头遭重创，转入地下抵抗。英雄救出同伴，穿过科瑞纳进入瓦比；一段任务取决于选择玛格丽特或密语大师。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Japanese army is here.Consulate DocksThe hero rescues his companions and crosses Corinne into Wabbi; a mission depends on choosing Margaret or the master of Mystery.

unresolved.legacyText: 瓦比王侯面临暗影军团侵袭。先前选择的英雄决定达沙前庭或卓坎诺要塞路线；之后可选择救援罗鳩村，或夺回瑟伯欣花园。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero of the previous choice decided on the path to the front court in Dasha or fort Zhocanor; he could then choose to rescue Rohian village or take back the Saberhin Garden.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄与帕拉瓦·约克交易，学会搭乘巨奴虫穿越致命的硫磺地带，并在摩拉废墟击败瓦蕾丝；此时黑暗逆袭已经侵入现实。
unresolved.englishDraft: Heroes trade with Parava York, learn to ride the giant insect through deadly.The Brimstone♪ The zone, andRuins of Morah Beating Wallace; right nowNightfallWe've got a break into reality.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄在折磨领域重遇寇米尔，解放受困灵魂，并在疯狂之门击败巫妖与白影。阿巴顿被击败后，逸散的力量威胁整个领域；寇米尔承接这股力量，成为掌管真相、知识与秘密的新神。
unresolved.englishDraft: Heroes met Komir in the torment, freed their trapped souls and wereGate of Madness Beating the Shaman and the White Shadow. Abbadon was defeated, and he got away.Strength Threatening the whole area; Komir takes over this.StrengthAnd become a new god in charge of truth, knowledge and secrets.

unresolved.legacyText: 角色从各自大陆的地震调查任务进入地下，结识奥格登与维克，并抵达北方之眼，与关及黑檀先锋队会合。
unresolved.englishDraft: The characters went underground from their own continent's seismic missions, met Ogden and Vic and arrived.Eye of the North Joining the Guang and Black Honolulu vanguards.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄召集乌拉、盖德与伦克等阿苏拉学者，保护魔像计划，并利用魔像突袭毁灭者巢穴。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero called together Assula scholars like Ulla, Ged and Lenk.PreservationAnd the Shaitans plan, and raid with them the den of the destroyers.

unresolved.legacyText: 关与英雄寻找失踪的黑檀先锋队，与反抗萨满阶层的夏尔烈焰战士皮雷合作，最终突袭要塞并解救兰玛队长等人。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Guang and the hero are looking for the missing Black Honolulus, and the Shire fire that fights the Samans.Warrior Pire cooperated, eventually raiding forts and rescued Captain Lama et al.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄协助乔拉终结变为诺恩熊的兄长，夺回家园并保护诺恩的圣地，赢得诺恩的支持。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero helped Jorah to end up being the brother of the Norn bear, take back his home and...PreservationNorn's holy place, won Norne's support.

unresolved.legacyText: 盟友集结后，英雄在席娃之心取得古老神器。贾里斯举行大矮人仪式，让多数矮人化为石矮人。联军深入中央传送室，击败大毁灭者，瓦解毁灭者的协同行动。
unresolved.englishDraft: After the ally was assembled, heroes gained their ancient powers in the heart of Sheva. Jarris held a Dwarve ceremony to turn most of them into rock dwarves. The coalition forces went deep.Central Transfer Chamber"and defeat the destroyer and destroy his concerted actions.

unresolved.legacyText: 前三项沙漠任务可按任意顺序完成，但飞升流程需要全部完成；这里并非三条互斥分支。
unresolved.englishDraft: The first three desert tasks can be accomplished in any order, but the flight process needs to be fully completed; not all three branches of each other are here.

unresolved.legacyText: 预言允许跳过部分前段任务；上述内容是剧情脉络，不表示每个任务都是通关必做条件。
unresolved.englishDraft: PropheciesThe fact that some of the previous tasks are allowed to be bypassed is a storyline and does not mean that each mission is subject to customs clearance.

unresolved.legacyText: 永恒之林与盖拉孵化所属于替代路线；继续主线不要求依次完成两条阵营路线。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Eternal Grove (explorable area)withGyala Hatchery (explorable area)It is an alternative route; the continuation of the main line does not require the completion of two camps in sequence.

unresolved.legacyText: 三项任务分别要求 Koss、Melonni、Tahlkora 随队。
unresolved.englishDraft: The three mandates require each of them. Koss、Melonni、Tahlkora Follow the line.

unresolved.legacyText: Pogahn Passage 与 Rilohn Refuge 是替代路线，分别要求 Margrid the Sly 与 Master of Whispers。Consulate Docks 和 Moddok Crevice 要求 Dunkoro；Venta Cemetery 要求 Koss；Kodonur Crossroads 要求 Zhed Shadowhoof。
unresolved.englishDraft: Pogahn Passage with Rilohn Refuge It's an alternative route. Separate requests. Margrid the Sly with Master of Whispers。Consulate Docks and Moddok Crevice Request Dunkoro；Venta Cemetery Request Koss；Kodonur Crossroads Request Zhed Shadowhoof。

unresolved.legacyText: Dasha Vestibule / Dzagonur Bastion 二选一；Jennur's Horde / Nundu Bay 也只需一项继续主线，后两者并非永久互斥。分别检查 Margrid / Master of Whispers、Koss / Melonni 的随队要求；Grand Court of Sebelkeh 要求 Tahlkora。
unresolved.englishDraft: Dasha Vestibule / Dzagonur Bastion Two or one;Jennur's Horde / Nundu Bay You can also check separately. Margrid / Master of Whispers、Koss / Melonni (a) The accompanying request;Grand Court of Sebelkeh Request Tahlkora。

unresolved.legacyText: 分别要求 Zhed Shadowhoof 与 General Morgahn 随队。
unresolved.englishDraft: Separate requests Zhed Shadowhoof with General Morgahn Follow the line.

unresolved.legacyText: 第二幕的阿苏拉、先锋队、诺恩三条故事线可以按任意顺序推进，最终需要全部完成；诺恩线中的后两条任务也有并列前置关系。
unresolved.englishDraft: The three storylines of Act II, Assula, the vanguard and Norn, can move in any order that ultimately requires all of them; the latter two tasks on the Norn line are also parallel.

numeric.english: Elite Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and hit 1…2…2 adjacent foes for 10…34…40 slashing damage.
numeric.chinese: 精英斧术攻击。命中时造成额外 10…34…40 点伤害，并对另外 1…2…2 名邻近敌人造成 10…34…40 点砍击伤害。

numeric.english: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Ferocious Strike that deals +13…25…28 damage. If that attack hits, you gain adrenaline and 3…9…10 Energy.
numeric.chinese: 精英宠物攻击。宠物尝试发动凶猛冲击，造成额外 13…25…28 点伤害。命中时，你获得怒气和 3…9…10 点能量。

numeric.english: Elite Bow Attack. All your preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 5 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +5…17…20 damage if they hit.
numeric.chinese: 精英弓术攻击。移除你的所有准备技能。向目标及其最多 5 名邻近敌人射箭，命中时各造成额外 5…17…20 点伤害。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 5…81…100 Health. Heal for an additional 30…98…115 Health if that ally is below 50% Health.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文。治疗目标盟友 5…81…100 点体力；若该盟友体力低于 50%，额外治疗 30…98…115 点体力。

numeric.english: Elite Signet. Transfer all negative conditions with 100…180…200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. (50% failure chance with Curses 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英纹章。将自身所有负面病症转移给目标敌人，持续时间为各病症剩余时间的 100…180…200%。诅咒属性不高于 4 时有 50% 失败几率。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 1…8…10 Energy. For each point of Energy lost, that foe takes 7 damage and all nearby foes take 75% of that damage.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文。目标敌人失去 1…8…10 点能量，每失去 1 点能量，该目标受到 7 点伤害；附近所有其他敌人受到该伤害的 75%。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 2…8…9 Energy. You gain 3 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文。目标敌人失去 2…8…9 点能量，每失去 1 点能量，你获得 3 点能量。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 25…53…60 seconds, you are attuned to Air, Fire, Water, and Earth and gain +1…2…2 to these attributes. You gain 1 Energy plus 50% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use magic associated with any of these elements.
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。持续 25…53…60 秒，与风、火、水、土四系元素调和，这四项属性提高 1…2…2。每次使用这些元素的魔法时，获得 1 点能量，加上该技能基础能量消耗的 50%。

numeric.english: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe takes 10…50…60 cold damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers an additional 10…50…60 cold damage and moves 90% slower for 1…4…5 seconds.
numeric.chinese: 精英降咒。目标受到 10…50…60 点冰冻伤害。若你的能量高于目标，该目标额外受到 10…50…60 点冰冻伤害，并在 1…4…5 秒内移动速度降低 90%。

numeric.english: Elite Hammer Attack. Target foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down. (50% failure chance with Hammer Mastery 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英鎚术攻击。击倒目标敌人及其所有邻近敌人。精通鎚术不高于 4 时，有 50% 几率失败。

numeric.english: Elite Skill. For 20 seconds you have an additional 90…258…300 Health, an additional 20 armor, and you take -1…8…10 less damage.
numeric.chinese: 精英技能。持续 20 秒，体力上限增加 90…258…300，护甲增加 20，所受伤害减少 1…8…10 点。

numeric.english: Elite Bow Attack. If Oath Shot hits, all of your skills except Oath Shot are recharged. If it misses, all of your skills are disabled for 10…5…4 seconds. (50% miss chance with Expertise 7 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英弓术攻击。命中时，除本技能外的所有技能立即完成冷却。未命中时，你的所有技能被禁用 10…5…4 秒。专精不高于 7 时，有 50% 几率未命中。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…38…45 seconds, you take 33% less damage from foes under the effects of Water Magic hexes. Whenever you cast an elemental spell, all non-spirit allies in earshot are healed for 50…210…250% of the Energy cost of the spell.
numeric.chinese: 精英 加持咒文. 用于 10…38…45 秒,你拿着 33减少敌方在战争影响下造成的损害的百分比 水系魔法 斧头. 每当你投出元素咒语, 所有非精神盟友的耳光 被治愈 50…210…250占总和的百分比 能量 咒语的代价。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, Energy Boon raises the maximum Health of you and target ally by 1…3…3 for each point of your respective maximum Energy. When this enchantment is first applied, you and your target gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain an additional 1 Energy for every 2 points you have in Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。持续 36…55…60 秒，你和目标盟友各自每有一点能量上限，便增加 1…3…3 点体力上限。初次施加此加持时，你和目标各获得 1…10…12 点能量；你的能量储存属性每有 2 点，你额外获得 1 点能量。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。持续 40…60 秒，你的各项元素属性提高 1。每次施放法术时，能量储存每有 10 级，你获得 1 点能量，并恢复相当于该法术能量消耗 100…300% 的体力。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。持续 40…60 秒，你的各项元素属性提高 1。每次施放法术时，能量储存每有 10 级，你获得 1 点能量，并恢复相当于该法术能量消耗 100…300% 的体力。

numeric.english: Elite Signet. For 5…17…20 seconds, all spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal 5…9…10 additional damage.
numeric.chinese: 精英信号。 用于 5…17…20 秒,所有灵魂你控制 在耳机攻击 33更快和交易的% 5…9…10 额外的破坏。

numeric.english: Shout. For 4 seconds and 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership, all party members within earshot take 20…35% less damage. Affected party members are healed for 35…60 Health when this shout ends.
numeric.chinese: 战嚎。持续 4 秒，领导属性每有 2 级再延长 1 秒；音量所及范围内所有队伍成员承受的伤害降低 20…35%。此战嚎结束时，受影响的队伍成员恢复 35…60 点体力。

numeric.english: Elite Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and hit 1…2…2 adjacent foes for 10…34…40 slashing damage.
numeric.chinese: 精英斧术攻击。命中时造成额外 10…34…40 点伤害，并对另外 1…2…2 名邻近敌人造成 10…34…40 点砍击伤害。

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * The Rotwing Recurve Bow is one of the items added to the game during the June 15, 2006 update.
* An easy way to get this item to drop is to tackle Rotscale while disguised as Keiran Thackeray in the Hearts of the North mini-mission, A Vengeance of Blades.
* Other items with this appearance:
**Ranger Forgotten Recurve Bow (unique)
**Ranger Forgotten Shortbow (unique)
**Ranger Keiran's Bow (Rotwing) (unique)
numeric.chinese:
Wiki 备注（中文）：* 旋翼反曲弓 是 6 月 15、2006 更新期间添加到游戏中的物品之一。
* 掉落该物品的一个简单方法是在北方之心迷你任务“刀锋复仇”中伪装成 Keiran Thackeray 对付 旋转鳞片。
* 其他具有此外观的物品：
**游侠 被遗忘的反曲弓（独特）
**游侠 被遗忘的短弓（独特）
**游侠 Keiran的弓（Rotwing）（独特）

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * The Forgotten Fan was one of the weapons added to the game during the June 15, 2006 update.
* Other items with this appearance:
**Necromancer Frozen Fan (unique)
**Ritualist Tattered Fan (unique)
This item has serious clipping issues on female monks, female necromancers and female mesmers.
numeric.chinese:
Wiki 备注（中文）：* 被遗忘的扇子 是 6 月 15、2006 更新期间添加到游戏中的武器之一。
* 其他具有此外观的物品：
**死灵 冰冻风扇（独特）
**祭祀 破烂扇子（独特）
该物品对女僧侣、女死灵法师和女催眠师有严重的剪裁问题。

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * The Totem Axe was one of the weapons added to the game during the June 15, 2006 update.
* The Totem Axe has a unique skin.
* The enchantments and energy boost make this item (plus Little John, Padraic, Rajazan's Fervor, Spirit of the Forgotten and Sharp Pointy Stick) especially popular among 55 monks/necromancers and Vow of Silence runners along with many other spellcasters.
numeric.chinese:
Wiki 备注（中文）：* 图腾斧 是 6 月 15、2006 更新期间添加到游戏中的武器之一。
* 图腾斧有独特的皮肤。
* 附魔和能量提升使该物品（加上小约翰、帕德莱克、拉贾赞的热情、被遗忘者的灵魂 和尖头棒）在 55 僧侣/死灵法师和 沉静誓约 奔跑者以及许多其他施法者中特别受欢迎。

numeric.english:

Wiki notes: * The two chances for a halved casting time are independent, and therefore calculated multiplicatively, giving a 36% chance to half casting time.
** Related to this calculation of two 20% events, there are two player terms that refer to associated modifiers:
*** 20/20 for caster items that have 20% chances to half casting time and recharge time, respectively.
*** 40/20/20 for staves that have two HCT modifiers, like this item, but use a 20% enchanting modifier rather than +30hp.
* Other items with this appearance:
**Necromancer Bellok's Staff (unique)
**Necromancer Spinal Staff
**Elementalist Unending Night's Grasp (unique)
numeric.chinese:
维基 备注：* 两次半铸造时间的机会是独立的,因此计算成倍,从而提供 36半个铸造时间的机会
 ** 与计算两个有关。 20 %事件,有两个玩家术语指相关的修饰符:
*** 20/20 供有下列物品的铸造者使用: 20分别获得一半的投影时间和回放时间的机率%.
*** 40/20/20 用于有两根重联调制器的分节点,例如此项,但使用 20迷人的修饰剂而不是+30汉字。
 * 具有这种外观的其他物品:

numeric.english: Chest rules: Fendi's Chest will spawn after defeating Soul of Fendi Nin in the final level of the Shards of Orr dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.
numeric.chinese: 宝箱规则：副本奖励：Shards of Orr 最终击败芬迪·宁之灵魂后 将产生产卵 欧尔残迹 地牢,我们去地牢吧 派对中的每个玩家可以打开胸口,在正常模式下会收到从投放列表中取出的一个物品(PDF).2 )),在硬模式下使用. 由每个玩家打开胸口后,会开始倒计时器,3分钟后将派对运出地牢.

After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.

After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.

numeric.english: Chest rules: The Prismatic Chest is the end chest of the Ooze Pit dungeon and will spawn when the three Prismatic Oozes and the two Hulking Volatile Oozes that each spawns are slain. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one Prismatic Gelatinous Material, as well as one item from the drop list in normal mode (two in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.
numeric.chinese: 宝箱规则：电话 副本奖励：Ooze Pit 是一个端口的胸口 乌兹地窖 地牢,当三个大乌兹和两个浩克伏活活火山被杀死时, 就会产下卵子,每个卵子都死了。 派对中的每个玩家可以打开胸口,并会得到一款"Prismatic Gelatinos"("Gelatinous"(意为"取出"))材料,以及从平时模式下放列表中取出一款("硬模式下取出两款"). 由每个玩家打开胸口后,会开始倒计时器,3分钟后将派对运出地牢.

numeric.english: Chest rules: Murakai's Chest is the end of dungeon reward for the Cathedral of Flames. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one Exquisite Surmia Carving, as well as one item from the following list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.
numeric.chinese: 宝箱规则：副本奖励：Cathedral of Flames 地牢的终结 奖励 火焰大教堂. 派对中的每位玩家可以打开胸口并获得一款精准的"Surmia活字雕刻",以及从以下列表中以正常方式获得一件物品(以"活字画"为主.2 )),在硬模式下使用. 由每个玩家打开胸口后,会开始倒计时器,3分钟后将派对运出地牢.

numeric.english: Chest rules: Hidesplitter's Chest will spawn after defeating Rragar Maneater and Hidesplitter in the final level of the Rragar's Menagerie dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported to Doomlore Shrine after three minutes.
numeric.chinese: 宝箱规则：副本奖励：Rragar's Menagerie  在最后一级击败了Rragar Maneter和Hidespliter后,将产生产卵。 拉喀的牢笼 地牢,我们去地牢吧 派对中的每个玩家可以打开胸口,在正常模式下会收到从投放列表中取出的一个物品(PDF).2 )),在硬模式下使用. 每一个玩家打开胸口后,一个倒计时器就会开始,派对会被运送到 末日传说神殿 3分钟后

After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and players will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: See: Dwarven brawling#Recommended equipment
* If doing Dwarven brawling only, for best results, apply the following modifications to increase the damage substantially (along with other benefits):
** Inscription: Brawn over Brains (+15% damage; the -5 energy is irrelevant, since the loss of energy is negated by Dwarven Brawling).
** Dagger Tang: Vampiric (minor healing while fighting), Sundering (extra damage), or Furious (faster adrenaline build).
** Dagger Handle: of Shelter (of Defense is almost as useful)
** Customization (if not sharing between characters).

* If you do not meet the required rank of 9 in Dagger Mastery, these will do 1-3 dmg, less than the default Brass Knuckles.
* You can use an identification kit on this item, but it will have no effect.
numeric.chinese:
维基 备注：参见:德华人争吵#推荐装备.
 * 如果只进行Dwarven争吵,为了取得最佳效果,应适用下列修改来大大增加损害(以及其他好处):
 ** 说明: " 脑 " (+)15损坏百分比;5 能源无关紧要,因为能源损失被德瓦文·布朗林所抵消.
 ** 唐剑:阴阳相通(在战斗中轻伤)、下行相通 (外伤)或怒气相通 怒气 建(建).
 ** 刀剑:庇护所(国防几乎同样有用)
 ** 自定义(如果不是字符之间共享的话).

 * 如果达不到规定的军衔, 9 内 匕首精通,这些会做 1-3 dmg,比默认的 Brass Knuckles 少.
 * 您可以使用此项目的身份识别包, 但不会产生任何效果。

numeric.english: With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), an instance of this skill's damage will trigger for each Dervish enchantment except for Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, or Vow of Revolution. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Aura of Holy Might (plus Aura of Holy Might itself).

numeric.english:
* Unthet Rotwood has five possible spawn locations in the Frozen Forest, which it shares with four other Pinesoul bosses - Afrhul Deeproot, Arkhel Havenwood, Esnhal Hardwood, and Obrhit Barkwood.
* Every Pinesoul boss is accompanied by 3 Ice Imps.

Unlike most Pinesoul, this boss is non-fleshy (and thus his corpse cannot be exploited and he is immune to disease, bleeding, and poison). This may be intentional, as it is the only necromancer plant in prophecies, with a name "Rotwood" that suggest that it is an undead tree.
numeric.chinese:
* 温特·罗特伍德 5个产卵地点可能位于 冰冻森林和另外四个松果尔老板分享 富尔德根 阿克赫尔·哈文伍德, 埃斯纳尔硬木,以及 奥布希特·巴克伍德.
每一个松果头都伴着 3 冰块之指.

与大多数平苏尔不同,这位老板是非花样活泼的(因此他的尸体不能被利用,他可以免疫疾病,出血和毒药).  这也许是有意的,因为它是预言中唯一一种花花果植物,其名称"罗特伍德"(Rotwood)暗示它是一棵不死树.

numeric.english:
* Shares his spawn point with Valetudo Rubor, Maligo Libens, Moles Quibus and Scelus Prosum.
* All five bosses spawn in the four locations shown. The two western locations is really one large area with three bosses. The other two spawn points have a single boss each.
* In the western spawn points, one boss can be seen patrolling while the other two will spawn out of the lava after about 5 minutes.
numeric.chinese:
* 与他分享产卵点 瓦莱图多·鲁博尔, 马利戈·利本斯, 鼹鼠奎布斯 财务报告和已审计财务报表 塞鲁斯·普罗苏姆.
 * 五个老大都在四个地点产卵。  两个西部地方其实是一个大片地区,有三个老板. 其余两个产卵点各有一个老板.
 * 在西部产卵点,可以看到一位老板巡逻,而另外两位则会在大约2个位置后从熔岩中产出。 5 几分钟。

* Unlike other zombies, it does not take double damage from holy damage.

** Holy Blessing for {{cost|50}}: +25 maximum health and +3 health regeneration.
* While Rotscale can be killed during A Vengeance of Blades, doing so will not complete the related Zaishen Bounty.

Ranger Hunter Mask is a mask art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign. This mask is available with either a Marksmanship or Expertise attribute bonus for all masks with lower than max armor rating. numeric.english:
Ranger Hunter Mask is a mask art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign. This mask is available with either a Marksmanship or Expertise attribute bonus for all masks with lower than max armor rating. At max armor rating this mask can be crafted with all ranger attribute bonuses. 



* This mask is available for ranger PvP-only characters to create as starter armor as PvP Archer Mask with +1 Marksmanship or PvP Hunter Mask with +1 Expertise. It is also available as a Basic PvP reward for +1 of any ranger attribute as Hunter Mask.
numeric.chinese:
游侠 · Hunter Mask 是一个在 $2 中引入的口罩艺术类型 预言 运动,也可在下列网址上查阅: 盟与敌 竞选活动。 面具可以使用,有的可以使用 弓术  或者说 专精 对所有装甲评级低于最大值的口罩给予属性奖励。  在最高装甲等级下,这个面具可以使用所有测距器属性奖金来设计. 



 * 此掩码可供护林员 PvP 仅限字符使用,以创建起动装甲像 Pvp Archer 遮罩, 并带有 +1 弓术 或 PvP 猎人面具带有 +1 专精. 也可作为+的基本PvP奖励1 任何护林员属性 猎人面具。

numeric.english:
Ranger Traveler Mask is a mask art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. This mask is available with a Wilderness Survival attribute bonus for all masks with lower than max armor rating. At max armor rating this mask can be crafted with all ranger attribute bonuses. 



* This mask is available for ranger PvP-only characters to create as starter armor with +1 Wilderness Survival, and is also available as a Basic PvP reward for +1 of any ranger attribute.
* This mask clips with several male ranger hairstyles.

numeric.english:
Monk Labyrinthine armor is a prestige art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign in the May 24th, 2007 update. 

The standard versions of this armor are Monk Dragon armor and Monk Star armor, and there is also another prestige variant called Monk Flowing armor.



* This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Exclusive Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
* This armor uses the same inventory icons as Monk Dragon armor.
* The necklace can only be seen if your guild cape is turned off.
* The female version's legs will occasionally clip through the skirt when raised high; this is easily seen during the dance animation.

 * 装甲被贴上标签 马翰石穴 独装甲在"抵抗"纪念碑 在战争中 史记殿堂.
 * 此装甲使用与 僧侣 · Dragon.
 * 只有关了你的盾牌披风才能看到项链。
 * 女性版的腿会偶尔被高高地抬起后从裙子上被夹住;这在舞蹈动画中很容易被看到.

numeric.english:
Necromancer Ragged Scar Pattern is a face scar pattern art introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. It is also available in Prophecies as part of the Initiate's set (Necromancer starter armor) or traded from collectors. Below maximum armor rating in Prophecies, it is crafted with an optional attribute bonus, all Necromancer attributes except Soul Reaping are available. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes.

Necromancer Devilish Scar Pattern is a name variant available from armorers in the Prophecies campaign. Below maximum armor rating it is crafted with a Soul Reaping attribute bonus. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes.
numeric.chinese:
死灵法师 · Ragged Scar Pattern 是一个在 3⁄4 ̄ ̧漯B 预言 运动,也可在下列网址上查阅: 盟与敌 运动和 北方之眼 扩张。 也可在下列网址查阅: 预言 启动集( 包含)死灵 起动装甲)或从收藏家处进行交易. 低于最高装甲等级 预言,它被设计 带有可选属性奖金,所有 死灵 属性除外 灵魂吸取 已备有。 最高装甲等级可以使用其中任何一种 死灵 属性。

死灵 恶魔刀疤图案(Devilish Scar Pattern)是美国海军陆战队的装甲兵部队在1952年使用的一种名称变体. 预言 竞选活动。 装甲等级以下,它被设计成 灵魂吸取 属性奖金。 最高装甲等级可以使用其中任何一种 死灵 属性。

It is also available in Prophecies as part of the Initiate's set (Necromancer starter armor) or traded from collectors. Below maximum armor rating in Prophecies, it is crafted with an optional attribute bonus, all Necromancer attributes except Soul Reaping are available. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes.

Necromancer Devilish Scar Pattern is a name variant available from armorers in the Prophecies campaign. Below maximum armor rating it is crafted with a Soul Reaping attribute bonus. At maximum armor rating it can be crafted with any of the Necromancer attributes.
numeric.chinese:
死灵法师 · Ragged Scar Pattern 是一个在 3⁄4 ̄ ̧漯B 预言 运动,也可在下列网址上查阅: 盟与敌 运动和 北方之眼 扩张。 也可在下列网址查阅: 预言 启动集( 包含)死灵 起动装甲)或从收藏家处进行交易. 低于最高装甲等级 预言,它被设计 带有可选属性奖金,所有 死灵 属性除外 灵魂吸取 已备有。 最高装甲等级可以使用其中任何一种 死灵 属性。

死灵 恶魔刀疤图案(Devilish Scar Pattern)是美国海军陆战队的装甲兵部队在1952年使用的一种名称变体. 预言 竞选活动。 装甲等级以下,它被设计成 灵魂吸取 属性奖金。 最高装甲等级可以使用其中任何一种 死灵 属性。

numeric.english:
Elementalist Third Eye is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor and is also craftable throughout the campaign, except at max armor rating. It is only available from crafters. It does not provide an attribute bonus.
An exception to this is the Third Eye given by Professor Yakkington in Pre-Searing which grants a bonus of Item's Attribute +1. It is also available in Nightfall, but only as starter headgear.
numeric.chinese:
元素使 · Third Eye 是一种在 预言 运动是起跑装甲,除最高装甲等级外,在整个战役中也是可制的。 只能从手工艺者那里获得。  它不提供属性奖金。
雅克京顿教授在"封口前"中给出的"第三眼"例外,它授予了"物品属性+"的奖金.1. 也可在下列网址查阅: 黑暗逆袭,但只是作为启动头盔。

Justiciar Thommis is the left most boss on the map. 
The Stone Summit Warders should be the first target as they have protective wards and can deal massive area of effect damage.
The other main target should be Stone Summit Defenders because they have Power Drain and Waste Not, Want Not allowing them to spam protection spells as well as interrupt

*Anti-knock down, there are large mobs of Modniir on the path to Justiciar Thommis.

numeric.english:
Once a player gets in radar range of the spawn point location, either Harn or Maxine will spawn and begin patrolling around the island. The boss will go counter-clockwise on its patrol path, so it is best to go clockwise through its patrol path as the boss will move toward you when it spawns and you avoid needing to chase the boss through numerous mobs. If you go clockwise through its patrol path, there are mobs of Flesh Golems and Mahgo Hydras that patrol in a circle outside of Ember Light Camp. Your party can stay near the Resurrection Shrine and pull each mob.

===Skill recommendations===
*If you go clockwise through its patrol path:
**You will only encounter spellcaster mobs (Dark Flame Dryders, Drakes, Flesh Golems, Mahgo Hydras, and Phantoms), so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the enemy spellcasters (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, Toxicity since Dark Flame Dryders use Chilblains, and Winnowing).
**The only physical attackers will be the Bone Minions created by the Flesh Golems via Animate Bone Minions, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here.
*This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
*If you go clockwise through the boss' patrol path, you can take this opportunity to obtain a Volcanic Rock.
*It's possible for Harn or Maxine to spawn at the beach on the north part of their path
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
numeric.chinese:
一旦玩家进入产卵点位置的雷达范围,哈恩或马克辛就会产卵并开始在岛上周围巡逻. 老板会逆时针走巡逻路线 所以最好顺时针顺着巡逻路线走 当老板在生下孩子的时候朝你走去 而你却不需要通过无数的暴徒追赶老板  如果你顺时针走过巡逻路线, 就会有一群暴徒 和马赫高水手在外边的一圈巡逻 残火营地.  你的派对可以待在复活圣殿附近 召集每个暴徒

技能建议
 如果你顺时针走过巡逻路线:
只能遇到咒语相伴的暴徒(Dark Flame Dryders, Drakes, Flesh Golems, Mahgo Hydras,和幽灵相伴),所以考虑带来反咒语的技巧和/或各种 游侠 自然仪式,可以使你的党受益,但不能使敌人的拼写者受益(例如: 风(黑檀), 怒火,自"黑暗火焰干燥器"使用Chilblains后,还有"温诺宁"的毒性.
唯一实际攻击者是 骨头 由花纹怪兽通过动画创造的小精灵 骨头 弱小的,所以技能 阻断,导致失明, 或造成盲症在这里是无效的。
 *这项征程最早于4月提出 25, 2009.
 *如果你顺时针走出老板的巡逻道,你可以借此机会得到火山岩.
赫恩或马克辛有可能在他们北边的海滩上产卵

numeric.english:
*Nicholas sometimes fails to appear in his expected location:
**Active quests can alter spawns in the area. To fix this, complete or abandon the local quests before returning. Alternatively, visit the area with a different character without the relevant quests.
**Some areas have variable spawns (e.g. Pockmark Flats); rezoning a few times will address this.
**He has sometimes failed to spawn due to the War in Kryta (e.g. in Kessex Peak (War in Kryta)); if not previously fixed by ArenaNet, you can work around this by using a character who has not started WiK or dropping any relevant bounties for characters that have finished WiK.
**Winds of Change might have a similar effect. For example, for the week of Putrid Cysts, you must not have Winds of Change active. To temporarily undo Winds of Change, take Memories of Purity from the Herald of Purity in Kaineng Center (requires completion of Cleansing Morostav Trail).
*Nicholas does not exchange items for gifts in two situations:
**If you enter an area before Nick's scheduled move time, but do not reach him until afterward, Nick will not speak to you at all.
**He attends The Wedding as a guest of Gwen, but not as a collector.
*Nicholas has occasionally been found facing a random object, obstructive landscape, or a wall.
*Nicksets are commonly traded in Kamadan or near the outpost where Nicholas is currently located. A nickset represents the exact quantity of an item required to obtain all 5 weekly Gifts of the Traveler. For example, if Nicholas requires 3 of an item per gift, a nickset consists of 15 of that item (3 × 5).
**Trading nicksets is generally beneficial for the buyer, as 5 Gifts of the Traveler are typically worth more than the nickset itself. The seller benefits from the convenience of not having to locate Nicholas in an explorable area. Note that prices are subject to fluctuation and may reach a point where Gifts of the Traveler are worth less than a nickset, making the trade unfavorable for the buyer.
Sometimes his greeting and/or reward text is not translated into one or more non-English languages. Please report any issues at the localization bug feedback pages so that they can be quickly resolved.
